items.summary: The opinions expressed by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis.

items.title: What is holding back sustainability measurement in construction?
items.summary: While professionals in construction increasingly agree on the need to reduce carbon emissions, improve product information and limit waste, new research has found that these priorities are not yet translating into routine practice across the industry.

items.title: Weaker EV targets could result in more than half of Rosebank’s emissions, ECIU warns
items.summary: A potential reduction in the UK’s electric vehicle (EV) sales targets could lead to additional emissions equivalent to 58% of those expected from burning the oil in the Rosebank field, according to new analysis by the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit (ECIU).

items.title: NEXT WEEK: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Taking place on 5 November, this upcoming webinar will explore how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: Win a free VIP pass to edie 27: Take our sustainability snapshot survey
items.summary: Sustainability professionals have the chance to win six months of access to edie’s digital Membership offering as well as a VIP pass to edie 27 in April by completing a short survey.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: Turning Scope 3 targets into funded action
items.summary: Join this edie webinar, held in partnership with South Pole on 12 November, to learn more about building the business case for Scope 3.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: How to prepare for the UK SRS
items.summary: This webinar, hosted in partnership with Simply Sustainable on 10 November, will explore how businesses can prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS), understand their current level of readiness and turn gaps into a practical implementation plan.

items.title: THREE WEEKS TO GO: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: Nature loss threatens 140 million jobs across Europe, study finds
items.summary: New data from Global Canopy has revealed that 140 million jobs across the European Union (EU), UK and Switzerland are under threat from domestic nature loss, equivalent to 60% of people employed in the region.

items.title: Q&A: Why are UK energy bills so high – and how could they be lowered?
items.summary: Energy bills in the UK have continued to soar in 2026, with intense debate raging about how to bring them down.
